construction_type: Symmetric zero-diagonal circulant graph state over F_7

replaces_impure_codetables_entry.literature_impact: Provides the first genuinely pure [[15, 0, 8]]_7 = AME(15, 7) state, replacing the impure product state |AME(14,7)> x |+>_15 listed on codetables.de and cited in arXiv:2609.11796 Fig. 1.

companion_F5_circulant_exhaustive_bound.search_space: All 5^7 = 78,125 symmetric zero-diagonal 15x15 circulant graph states over F_5
companion_F5_circulant_exhaustive_bound.implication: No symmetric circulant graph state over the prime base field F_5 is AME(15, 5); any pure stabilizer [[15, 0, 8]]_5 state must either break Z_15 graph symmetry or use non-graph symplectic / Hermitian self-dual structure over GF(5^2) = F_25.
